title: Stale PR salvage via maintainer-owned branch
objective: Recover useful closed-PR work through maintainer-owned branches with attribution and validation, without importing unsafe or unreviewed changes.
source_rule: May 2026 stale-PR cleanup: stale closure is queue hygiene, not loss of useful work.
allowed_evidence: closed and merged PR diffs and review threads
maintainer salvage decisions recorded in the ledger
git diff --check output for the candidate branch
forbidden_actions: closing, reopening, or commenting on PRs
copying private paths, secrets, or raw personal context
acceptance_gates: source PR is credited in the salvage branch and the ledger
no private operator context is copied into the branch
stale bulk localization waits for translator/manual review
ledger row records the salvage state and result
release and publication actions stay approval-gated
